Whew! This is probably the last big update for Planate. One more update and I can finally call it a finished theme — not including bug-fixes, of course. Here's what I did:

  • Organized code! I tried to make the code as efficient and organized as possible. It has a nice side effect, too — pages will load that much faster. Tell me that's not good.
  • Readability! As I've been told, good web design focuses first on readability, and then aesthetics. I increased the contrast on the text in some areas so we're not leaving our sight-impaired buddies behind! I also added a hover-underline to most hyperlinks.
  • Coverage! I scaled the entire page, looking for elements that I may have missed and included them in! Including that treacherous, character-hog table on the 'submit a link' page.
  • A 'message the moderators' button! Because, let's face it, buttons are awesome. Of course, it doesn't work now, but we all know that speedy /u/Atko-nzales, with his fingers of magic, will make it happen soon.
  • Subverse name on the sidebar has a new effect.

  • Sidebar infoboxes don't have such a distracting border. Also — since I haven't updated the documentation yet — these special boxes are created with a combination of Heading2 + Blockquote markup: 

    ## About Planate 

> Planate is a CSS theme I created to be used by subverses.
  • Sidebar headings like 'Submission Info', 'Score', 'Moderators', and 'Admin Tools' have received some care, finally!
  • Search box design finalized. It has a nice border-gets-darker effect when you click on it!

There are probably some more changes, but I'm terrible at keeping version logs. I had to look at the page itself — the github app told me that the changes were too big, so no help there.

Finally, I still have some work before the theme is finished. Mainly:

  • Awesome-ize the mobile view of the theme by adjusting the layouts a bit. At the moment, it looks kind of weird.
  • Documentation on the CSS code. I don't have to, but I love to!
  • Top header bar. It still needs a little work.
  • Post and comment markdown. I keep forgetting to test it.

Also, I'll need to see if the theme has any problems if the screen size is really wide. I use WhoaVerse on my second, vertical monitor. Tell me if you see anything weird!

Well, I think I've said my peace. Happy whoaversing, everyone!
[Update] Planate v1.3 — Organize code, better readability, polishing; theme is 98% complete.
